segments.name: Global Spine
segments.description: Provides implantable medical devices, biologics, enabling technologies and regenerative solutions for patients with spine diseases and traumas.
segments.evidence: Within the Global Spine segment, we provide implantable medical devices, biologics, enabling technologies, and other regenerative solutions which aim to restore the quality of life of patients suffering from diseases and traumas of the spine.

segments.name: Global Limb Reconstruction
segments.evidence: Orthofix operates the business through two reporting segments, Global Spine and Global Limb Reconstruction (formerly "Global Orthopedics"), which accounted for 84% and 16% of our total net sales in 2025, respectively.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net sales from selling medical devices and tissue products to healthcare providers through distributors and direct sales representatives, plus marketing service fees.
